title: Address
description: A named network address object (R-012). Exactly one of subnet, range, fqdn, mac must be set. A single host is a /32 or /128 subnet. The predefined Addresses 'any' (0.0.0.0/0) and 'any6' (::/0) ship with every configuration (R-012.1) and carry predefined: true; their spec is immutable (validator check).

interface.description: Optional hint restricting where this Address is expected to appear (used by the UI and by DHCP static bindings). Not a match criterion in Policies.

fqdn.description: Resolved periodically by the DNS Subsystem; the resolved set is compiled into the Data Plane.

mac.description: Matches on source MAC only; valid only as Source in Policies whose incoming side is a directly attached Interface.

predefined.description: True only for the shipped objects any / any6.
